name: ExportPanel
description: Standalone export controls and the exact encoded preview/file size.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, renderPreview, onExport, formats: provided, disabled, profile, labels, className }: ExportPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: formats
props.description: Actual codec availability; omit to probe native and optional encoders on mount.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ size: string; export: string; metadata: string; batch: string; format: string; quality: string; width: string; height: string; alpha: string; preserve: string; strip: string; stripGps: string; preview: string; bytes: string; unavailable: string; loading: string; failed: string; open: string; projectOpen: string; projectSave: string; paste: string; copy: string; drop: string; browse: string; run: string; cancel: string; files: string; progress: string; empty: string; cameraMake: string; cameraModel: string; lens: string; exposureSeconds: string; aperture: string; iso: string; focalLengthMm: string; date: string; orientation: string; gps: string; profile: string; recover: string; autosave: string; pending: string; done: string; error: string; aborted: string; noExport: string; icc: string; iccNote: string; avifMetadata: string; project: string; recovery: string; sources: string; }> | undefined

props.name: onExport
props.description: The host decides what delivery means. Without this callback no Export button is shown.

props.name: profile
props.description: A source profile which the host permits re-embedding. No colour conversion occurs.

props.name: renderPreview
props.description: Inject composed pixels/encoding for a live compressed preview.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled export settings; omit to use local state.
